messages:
Eva: Heads up — ACME (tenant acme-prod) onboarding is blocked. Voucher VCHR-57 was redeemed but it landed on the Hosted sku instead of the Dedicated sku they purchased. Demo scheduled for tomorrow, customer cannot provision dedicated capacity.

Marcus: Ugh. Do we have the redemption audit? Which SKU did it actually apply to?

Eva: According to the billing event it applied to `hosted-pro`. Customer purchased `dedicated.large`. Tenant ID: tenant_0a1b2c3d. Voucher: VCHR-57. Timestamp: 2024-11-03T16:14:28Z. Error when provisioning dedicated pool: "no reserved capacity found for sku 'dedicated.large'".

Priya: Can you paste the redemption event snippet? I want to see the API call/response.

Eva: Pasting the billing response we got back from the voucher service:

```
POST /v1/vouchers/redeem
{
  "code": "VCHR-57",
  "account": "tenant_0a1b2c3d"
}

200 OK
{
  "code": "VCHR-57",
  "applied_to": "hosted-pro",
  "redeemed_by": "tenant_0a1b2c3d",
  "redeemed_at": "2024-11-03T16:14:28Z"
}
```

billing-bot: Voucher VCHR-57 marked as redeemed for account tenant_0a1b2c3d at 2024-11-03T16:14:28Z. :white_check_mark:

Marcus: Thanks. Two options: 1) Reassign voucher to the correct SKU (preferred), or 2) Manually issue an equivalent credit to the dedicated billing bucket so they can finish provisioning. Both require billing team approval / audit trail.

Priya: I can run a reassign but need PO# and approval note in the ticket. Reassign is `irreversible` in ledger terms unless we do a compensating credit.

Marcus: I'll open an incident ticket and get PO from the customer. EVA please confirm customer's billing contact.

Eva: Contact is tracy@acme.com (ACME finance). PO number they provided earlier: PO-8891-ACME (they said that covers the reserved capacity). I'll DM Tracy and ask for explicit write-up.

Priya: Nice. If the customer confirms, here's the admin API to reassign a voucher (internal only):

```
PATCH /v1/admin/vouchers/VCHR-57
Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>
{
  "target_sku": "dedicated.large",
  "reason": "misapplied to hosted during onboarding — customer purchased dedicated.large (PO-8891-ACME)"
}
```

Priya: After the reassignment, I'll trigger a reconcile job to move ledger entries and then mark the voucher as consumed against the dedicated bucket. This should unblock provisioning within ~10 min.

Marcus: I'll make the INC now and ping legal for the audit line. ETA: 30m to get PO confirmation from customer.

support-bot: Ticket INC-2024-2196 created and assigned to Priya. SLA: high. Updates will be posted here. :spiral_calendar:

Eva: Thanks — I'll chase Tracy now and update this thread with PO confirmation so Priya can proceed.

Marcus: If Priya needs me to coordinate the provisioning side after ledger update I can stand by. :phone:

Priya: Will wait for PO and then action. Leaving a note: if for any reason reassignment cannot be executed, we'll issue equivalent dedicated credit and close with an audit trail.

billing-bot: Reassignment request logged. Audit id: AUD-2024-0917. Waiting approval.

Eva: PO confirmed by Tracy (tracy@acme.com). She approved the reassignment in email chain. Forwarding now.

Priya: I have approval. Proceeding to reassign now — will update when complete.

support-bot: Voucher VCHR-57 reassigned to dedicated.large. Reconcile job started. INC-2024-2196 updated.

Priya: Reconcile finished. Ledger updated, provisioning can be retried. Please attempt provisioning and confirm.

Marcus: Provisioning retried and succeeded for tenant_0a1b2c3d. Dedicated pool active. Customer notified.

Eva: Demo confirmed with customer. Closing loop — great work everyone. :tada:
